name: es 與 si 對調（對調後列數、每列格數都非 0 才呼叫，避免原版以外的長迴圈）
replace: if (rd8(m, LIN(obj_off, (uint16_t)(obj_seg + 0x26u))) != 0 && rd8(m, LIN(obj_off, (uint16_t)(obj_seg + 0x27u))) != 0) f_2376_02DE(m, 0, obj_off, obj_seg);

name: si 加 1（新位置的列數、每列格數都非 0 才呼叫）
replace: if (rd8(m, LIN(obj_seg, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x27u))) != 0 && rd8(m, LIN(obj_seg, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x28u))) != 0) f_2376_02DE(m, 0, obj_seg, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 1u));

name: 改呼叫 02F2（欄位位移不同；+0x21、+0x22 非 0 才呼叫）
replace: { extern void f_2376_02F2(Mem *, uint16_t, uint16_t, uint16_t); if (rd8(m, LIN(obj_seg, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x21u))) != 0 && rd8(m, LIN(obj_seg, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x22u))) != 0) f_2376_02F2(m, 0, obj_seg, obj_off); }

name: es 固定 DGROUP（新位置的列數、每列格數都非 0 才呼叫）
replace: if (rd8(m, LIN(GIN3_DS, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x26u))) != 0 && rd8(m, LIN(GIN3_DS, (uint16_t)(obj_off + 0x27u))) != 0) f_2376_02DE(m, 0, GIN3_DS, obj_off);
